plugins.name: babelstone-engine
plugins.description: The babelstone engine dev toolchain (ADR-PC-020 §P1–§P4): §P1 hooks (ADR-immutability, engine-analyser/PII/spec-coverage surfacing, PlantUML re-render, session-push protocol, bd prime), §P2 skills (new-adr, amend-adr, supersede-adr, pack-author, new-family-schema, new-event, new-store-migration, bd-lint-fill, post-merge-cleanup), and §P3 review subagents (adr-conformance, financial-math-reviewer, contract-reviewer, replay-determinism-auditor, doc-consistency).
